messages:
anya: quick heads-up 

We started getting tenant escalations: client's legacy integrations failing after v2 flip. Looks like many proxies never send X-Client-Version.

chris: saw the traces. schema validation in v2 rejects certain nested fields older clients still send. Most common path = /generate/chat.

devon: what if we add a "compat-detect" sampler that conservatively tags requests missing the header and surfaces a tenant-level ratio in console (not full payload). no routing changes initially, just visibility.

anya: +1. visibility first helps SEs and customers. But we should also be pragmatic: long tail tenants with old SDKs won't update. Need an ops-safe fallback plan.

morgan: propose two phased controls: (A) non-invasive: console card + tenant missing_header_ratio + recent example client_ids (hashed) ; (B) phased fallback: tenant grace that routes up to X headerless QPS to v1 for 48h, with capacity guard.

devon: routing proto (pseudo):
```
if header(X-Client-Version) -> route:v2
else if tenant.grace_enabled && v1_capacity_ok -> route:v1 (mark=compat_grace)
else -> route:v2 (mark=compat_warning)
```

chris: +1 to marking. We must annotate events for billing and analytics: compat_grace should be non-billable or billed at v1 rate until product decides. Otherwise finance tickets incoming.

morgan: capacity guard idea: compute v1_margin = v1_total_capacity - v1_current_qps; allow fallback only if v1_margin > max(tenant_grace_qps, 10% of v1_total). If margin dips, auto-revoke grace and DM SE.

ops-bot: alert: large bump in compat-warning responses in eu-central-1, 5.2% of requests in last 5m.

anya: ok owners: devon -> implement telemetry sampler and console card; morgan -> runtime gate + grace flow; chris -> billing annotation + analytics event. I'll write a short RFC with thresholds and sample UI copy.

devon: I'll start a small dataflow to capture missing_header_ratio by tenant and a hashed client id sample. Will use 1% sampling to keep cost low.

chris: add a lightweight response header during the probe phase so integrators see it: `X-Redwood-Compat: header-missing; rfc=https://redwood.ai/compat`. non-breaking and helpful.

morgan: will sketch console mock later. Suggest the console action be "Enable 48h compat grace" and show estimated forward QPS and v1 margin before confirming.

anya: great. timeline: telemetry + console card by EOD tomorrow, runtime gate prototype by end of week. RFC Monday. Thanks all.
